vandasva marutaḥ aha gāvaḥ cit gha samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ

column2: cit bharantaḥ avasyavaḥ vāje citram havāmahe upa tvā karman ūtaye saḥ naḥ yuvā
śīhi naḥ vaso iti vāje suśipra gomati yaḥ naḥ idamidam purā pra vasyaḥ ānināya
sute mā te godatra niḥ arāma rādhasaḥ indra mā te gṛhāmahi dṛḷhā cit
vām śubhaḥ patī iti ā dhenuḥiva dhāvatu rathaḥ yaḥ vām trivandhuraḥ hiraṇyaabhīśuḥ
yat adhrigāvaḥ adhrigū iti adhrigū idā cit ahnaḥ aśvinā havāmahe vayam
vartiḥ yāsiṣṭam madhupātamā narā gomat dasrā hiraṇyavat suprāvargam suvīryam
gṛṇe tam iti vaḥ stuṣe yajñebhiḥ adbhutakratum yam kṛpā sūdayante it mitram na jane
suvidam ukṣaṇyuḥ aprīṇāt ṛṣiḥ mahaḥ rāye tam iti tvā sam idhīmahi uśanā kāvyaḥ
naspatīnām viprāḥ agnim avase pratnam īḷate mahaḥ viśvān abhi sataḥ abhi
darṣi janānām dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo iti stavamānaḥ ā bhara na te savyam na dakṣiṇam hastam varante
rādhase rāye dyumnāya śavase ca girvaṇaḥ ā indum indrāya siñcata pibāti
ni vīryā na rādhaḥ parietave jyotiḥ na viśvam abhi asti dakṣiṇā stuhi
rādhaḥ śatavat sahasravat yat tvā pṛcchāt ījānaḥ kuhayā kuhayākṛte eṣaḥ
tā ṛtavānā ni sedatuḥ sāmrājyāya sukratū iti sukratū dhṛtavratā kṣatriyā
vi viśpatiḥ tasya vratāni anu vaḥ carāmasi anu pūrvāṇi okyā sāmrājyasya saścima
huve sadhastutyāya sūriṣu atūrtadakṣā vṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū yuvam varo iti
vat sumatibhiḥ upa viprau iha ā gatam aśvinā su ṛṣe stuhi kuvit te śravataḥ
amartyā uta syā śvetayāvarī vāhiṣṭhā vām nadīnām sindhuḥ hiraṇyavartaniḥ
ṛcā yāmi marutaḥ brahmaṇaḥ patim devān avaḥ vareṇyam ā paśum gāsi pṛthivīm
vāmahe manuṣvat iddhaagnayaḥ ā pra yāta marutaḥ viṣṇo iti aśvinā pūṣan
nave samanyavaḥ viśve sākam sarātayaḥ te naḥ adya te aparam tuce tu naḥ bhavantu
utite yat madhyandine ātuci vāmam dhattha manave viśvavedasaḥ juhvānāya
taḥ deveṣu nidhruviḥ vajram āhitam tena vṛtrāṇi jighnate tigmam āyudham śuciḥ
bhyam śarma saprathaḥ gave aśvāya yacchata yaḥ yajāti yajāte it
romaśam hataḥ deveṣu kṛṇutaḥ duvaḥ vṛṇīmahe nadīnām ā viṣṇoḥ sacābhuvaḥ
oṃ pra kṛtāni triṃśan medhātithir vayaṃ ghaikonā medhyātithir bārhataṃ

column2: riṇan apaḥ ni arbudasya viṣṭapam varṣmāṇam bṛhataḥ tira kṛṣe tat indra paiṃsyam prati
bhiḥ ūtibhiḥ tam indram abhi gāyata āyantāram mahi sthiram pṛtanāsu
āpaḥ na sadhryak adhvaryo iti ā tu hi siñca somam vīrāya śipriṇe bhara sutasya
hi gāya andhasaḥ made indrāya medhyaatithe yaḥ sammiślaḥ haryoḥ yaḥ sute sacā vajrī
vṛṣo iti arvāvati śrutaḥ vṛṣaṇaḥ te abhīśavaḥ vṛṣā kaśā hiraṇyayī vṛṣā rathaḥ
raghum saptī iti cit gha madacyutā mithunā vahataḥ ratham eva it dhūḥ vṛṣṇaḥ
sya pītaye upaśruti uktheṣu raṇaya iha sarūpaiḥ ā su naḥ gahi
rutbhiḥ bhṛgubhiḥ sacābhuvā juṣethām yajñam bodhatam havasya me viśvā iha devau savanā
rakṣāṃsi sedhatam amīvāḥ somam sunvataḥ aśvinā kṣatram nṝn dhenūḥ viśaḥ
vaḥ mahaḥ kṛdhi śyāvaaśvasya sunvataḥ tathā śṛṇu yathā aśṛṇoḥ atreḥ karmāṇi
sadhastutī iti sadhastutī indrāgnī iti ā gatam narā imā juṣethām savanā yebhiḥ havyāni
si pūrvyaḥ śivaḥ dūtaḥ vivasvataḥ tattat agniḥ vayaḥ dadhe yathāyathā
ca naḥ vipraḥ dūtaḥ parikṛtaḥ tvam naḥ agne āyuṣu tvam deveṣu pūrvya vasvaḥ ekaḥ
jihmabāram apaūrṇutaḥ indraḥ īśānaḥ ojasā api vṛśca purāṇavat vratateḥiva
ohate āṇḍā śuṣṇasya bhedati ajaiḥ svaḥvatīḥ apaḥ eva indrāgnibhyām
nāmāni guhyā saḥ kaviḥ kāvyā puru rūpam dyauḥiva puṣyati yasmin
asuraḥ viśvavedāḥ amimīta varimāṇam pṛthivyāḥ ā asīdat viśvā
gmāḥ agne tava tviṣaḥ datbhiḥ vanāni bapsati harayaḥ dhūmaketavaḥ vātajūtāḥ
guvat śuce manuṣvat agne āhuta aṅgirasvat havāmahe tvam hi agne
viśām rājānam adbhutam adhiakṣam dharmaṇām imam agnim īḷe saḥ ūṃ iti śravat agnim
idhā agnim duvasyata ghṛtaiḥ bodhayata atithim ā asmin havyā juhotana agne
sma deva riṣataḥ bhindhi dveṣaḥ sahaḥkṛta agniḥ pratnena manmanā śumbhānaḥ tanvam svām kaviḥ
tu viśvahā agne sakhyasya bodhi naḥ yat agne syām aham tvam tvam vā gha syāḥ aham
bhiḥ ā bundam vṛtrahā dade jātaḥ pṛcchat vi mātaram ke ugrāḥ ke ha śṛṇvire
yathā gayam kakuham cit tvā kave mandantu dhṛṣṇo iti indavaḥ ā tvā paṇim yat īmahe
mākīm brahmadviṣaḥ vanaḥ iha tvā goparīṇasā mahe mandantu rādhase saraḥ gauraḥ yathā
mā dvayoḥ uta triṣu vadhīḥ mā śūra bhūriṣu bibhaya hi tvāvataḥ ugrāt abhiprabhaṅginaḥ
oṃ tvāvatas trayastriṃśad vaśośvya āsa ādikā nītasya pṛthuśravaso

column2: taḥ yam aryamā mitraḥ pānti adruhaḥ dadhānaḥ gomat aśvavat suvīryam ādityajūtaḥ
mānuṣā yugā indram havante taviṣam yatasrucaḥ saḥ naḥ vājeṣu avitā puruvasuḥ
sūnṛta samrāṭ sahurim sahantam bhujyum vājeṣu pūrvyam ā saḥ etu yaḥ īvat
cit ūṃ iti tmanā amandat citram dāvane araṭve akṣe nahuṣe sukṛtvani
tayaḥ suūtayaḥ vaḥ ūtayaḥ vida devāḥ aghānām ādityāsaḥ apaākṛtim pakṣā vayaḥ
yat devāḥ śarma śaraṇam yat bhadram yat anāturam tridhātu yat varūthyam tat
masi eva duḥsvapnyam sarvam āptye sam nayāmasi ajaiṣma adya asanāma ca abhūma
ritrāt uta mā srāmāt yavayantu indavaḥ agnim na mā mathitam sam didīpaḥ
cīḥ abhaiṣuḥ ā somaḥ asmān aruhat vihāyāḥ aganma yatra pratirante āyuḥ
jigāti dhṛṣṇuyā hanti vṛtrāṇi dāśuṣe gireḥiva pra rasāḥ asya pinvire datrāṇi purubhojasaḥ
yathā pra āvaḥ maghavan medhyaatithim yathā nīpaatithim dhane yathā kaṇve maghavan
rādhasaḥ mahaḥ vasutvanā sadā pīpetha dāśuṣe parāvati divi yujānaḥ indra haribhiḥ
dhātum uttame pade saḥ tu imā viśvā bhuvanāni cikradat āt it janiṣṭa paiṃsyam
indavaḥ yathā manau vivasvati somam śakra apibaḥ sutam yathā trite chandaḥ indra
dra girvaṇaḥ śikṣo iti śikṣasi dāśuṣe asmākam giraḥ uta sustutim vaso iti kaṇvavat
pasi indra nedīyaḥ ā it ihi mitamedhābhiḥ ūtibhiḥ ā śaṃtama śaṃtamābhiḥ
naḥ vasavaḥ rudrāḥ avase naḥ ā gaman śṛṇvantu marutaḥ havam pūṣā viṣṇuḥ havanam me
ukṣaṇaḥ divi tāraḥ na rocante mahnā divam na tastabhuḥ śatam veṇūn śatam śunaḥ
jatrā ā agacchatam nāsatyā śacībhiḥ idam tṛtīyam savanam pibāthaḥ yuvām devāḥ
tam ketumantam tricakram sukham ratham susadam bhūrivāram citramaghā yasya yoge adhijajñe
drāvaruṇā ghṛtaścutaḥ tribhiḥ sāptebhiḥ avatam śubhaḥ patī iti indrāvaruṇā yat ṛṣibhyaḥ
ā vaso iti gahi mandasva dhītibhiḥ hitaḥ tvam it saprathāḥ asi agne trātaḥ ṛtaḥ
ā naḥ agne vayaḥvṛdham rayim pāvaka śaṃsyam rāsva ca naḥ upamāte puruspṛham sunītī
ā hotāram carṣaṇīnām ketena śarman sacate susāmani agne tubhyam cikitvanā
kratvā yathā vaśaḥ sanema vājam tava śiprin avasā makṣu cit yantaḥ adrivaḥ
me śṛṇavat havam vasuyavaḥ vasupatim śatakratum stomaiḥ indram havāmahe na
śvataḥ āre asmat kṛṇuhi daivyam bhayam āre hetīḥ adevīḥ
cit dhṛṣat manaḥ kṛṇoṣi indra yat tvam tīvraiḥ somaiḥ saparyataḥ namaḥbhiḥ
bhūri jyotīṃṣi sunvataḥ saḥ pūrvyaḥ mahānām venaḥ kratubhiḥ ānaje yasya
viodane uru kramiṣṭa jīvase yavam na paśvaḥ ā dade tat dadhānāḥ avasyavaḥ
divā sute vayam naktam havāmahe asmākam kāmam ā pṛṇa syaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ yuvā
hantu bibhrataḥ indra gṛṇīṣe iti stuṣe mahān ugraḥ īśānakṛt ā ihi naḥ sutam piba
indraḥ gavyasya vṛtrahā nikhātam cit yaḥ purusambhṛtam vasu ut it vapati
kat iti vṛtraghnaḥ astṛtam indraḥ viśvān bekanāṭān ahaḥdṛśaḥ uta kratvā
ṣṭaye mitraḥ naḥ ati aṃhatim varuṇaḥ parṣat aryamā ādityāsaḥ yathā viduḥ teṣām hi
bdhāsaḥ svayaśasaḥ vratā rakṣante adruhaḥ te naḥ āsnaḥ vṛkāṇām ādityāsaḥ mumocata
hariḥ oṃ ā tvaikonā priyamedham ādāv anuṣṭummukhās tṛcāś catvāro

column2: oṃ ā tvā ratham yathā ūtaye sumnāya vartayāmasi tuvikūrmim ṛtisaham indra
rvaṇaḥtama indra yathā cit āvitha vājeṣu purumāyyam yasya te svādu sakhyam
vaḥ medhasātaye puramdhyā ā vivāsati nadam vaḥ odatīnām nadam yoyuvatīnām patim vaḥ
sphuram gṛbhāyata somam indrāya pātave apāt indraḥ apāt agniḥ viśve devāḥ
āśata yaḥ rājā carṣaṇīnām yātā rathebhiḥ adhriguḥ viśvāsām
etagvā cit yaḥ etaśā yuyojate harī iti indraḥ yuyojate tam vaḥ mahaḥ mahāyyam
ekam it śara vatsān parādadaḥ karṇagṛhya maghavā śauradevyaḥ vatsam naḥ tribhyaḥ ā
raśociṣam giraḥ yantu darśatam accha yajñāsaḥ namasā puruvasum purupraśastam ūtaye
mi aṃśum sīdat hotā manau adhi juṣāṇaḥ asya sakhyam antaḥ icchanti tam jane
vatam mahī iti yajñasya rapsudā ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ā sute siñcata śriyam
adya karhi karhi cit śuśrūyātam imam havam aśvinā yāmahūtamā nediṣṭham
vaḥ atithim vājayantaḥ purupriyam agnim vaḥ duryam vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ
vaḥ dadhīta vṛtratūrye aśvam it gām rathaprām tveṣam indram na satpatim yasya śravāṃsi
yajñiyaḥ bhuvaḥ ayam agniḥ sahasriṇaḥ vājasya śatinaḥ patiḥ mūrdhā kaviḥ
ducchunā vardha naḥ amavat śavaḥ yasya ajuṣat namasvinaḥ śamīm aduḥmakhasya
ḍhvaḥ piba somam śatakrato iti śatakrato asmin yajñe purustuta tubhya it
triṃśatam indraḥ somasya kāṇukā abhi gandharvam atṛṇat abudhneṣu rajaḥsu ā
tā ca śūra gonām ā naḥ bhara viañjanam gām aśvam abhiañjanam sacā manā
sya vā pūrdhi yavasya kāśinā ayam kṛtnuḥ agṛbhītaḥ viśvajit utbhit it
apa dviṣaḥ sedha mīḍhvaḥ apa sridhaḥ sedha nahi anyam balā akaram marḍitāram
vṛdhat vaḥ amṛtāḥ amandīt ekadyūḥ devāḥ uta yāḥ ca devīḥ tasmai iti rādhaḥ
oṃ ā pra devānāṃ vaiśvadevaṃ preṣṭham uśanā kāvya āgneyam ā me kṛṣṇa
column3: INVOCATION; INDEX; padapatha begins line 9: ā pra drava parāvataḥ arvāvataḥ ca vṛtrahan

column2: saḥ mādayiṣṇavaḥ piba dadhṛk yathā ociṣe iṣā mandasva āt iti te aram
vāmam varuṇa śaṃsyam vāmam hi āvṛṇīmahe vāmasya hi pracetasaḥ īśānāsaḥ riśādasaḥ
śvāḥ asmabhyam sukṣitīḥ vājadraviṇasaḥ giraḥ kasya nūnam parīṇasaḥ dhiyaḥ
nāsatyā aśvinā pra avatam yuvam ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayaḥbhuvā ubhā dakṣasya
pātam vedasā vayaḥ tā vartiḥ yātam upa vṛktabarhiṣaḥ juṣṭam yajñam diviṣṭiṣu
abhi majmanā ā tvā ayam arkaḥ ūtaye vavartati yam gotamāḥ ajījanan pra hi
paḥ javasā vi mātaraḥ hanaḥ vṛtram jaya svaḥ iti svaḥ yat jāyathāḥ apūrvya maghavan
se saḥ tvam śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe arvāñcam rayim ā kṛdhi tvam indra yaśāḥ asi
śiraḥ tatasya urvarām āt idam me upa udare asau ca yā naḥ urvarā āt imām tanvam
ūtaye yudhmam santam anarvāṇam somapām anapacyutam naram avāryakratum śikṣa
śravaḥtamaḥ yaḥ indra vṛtrahantamaḥ yaḥ ojaḥdātamaḥ madaḥ vidma hi yaḥ te adrivaḥ
vimagha viśvebhiḥ dhāyi dhātṛbhiḥ adha cit indra me sacā mo iti brahmāiva
yat vā pravṛddha satpate na marai iti manyase uto iti tat satyam it tava
tviṣaḥ viśve devāsaḥ akramuḥ vidat mṛgasya tān amaḥ āt iti me nivaraḥ
ojasā tubhyam somāḥ sutāḥ ime stīrṇam barhiḥ vibhāvaso iti vibhāvaso stotṛbhyaḥ
thānām yasyāḥ devāḥ upasthe vratā viśve dhārayante sūryāmāsā dṛśe kam marutaḥ
rvaṇaḥ abhi tvā sam anūṣata indra vatsam na mātaraḥ ā tvā śukrāḥ acucyavuḥ sutāsaḥ
ratnāni dāśuṣe śuddhaḥ vṛtrāṇi jighnase śuddhaḥ vājam sisāsasi asmai
jajāna viśvā jātāni avarāṇi asmāt indreṇa mitram didhiṣema gīḥbhiḥ
nvi śrutasya juṣṭatarasya tat viviḍḍhi yat te indraḥ jujoṣat stuhi sustutim
tha tvam śuṣṇasya ava atiraḥ vadhatraiḥ tvam gāḥ indra śacyā it avindaḥ
smin tam dhehi mā paṇau yaḥ indra sasti avrataḥ anusvāpam adevayuḥ svaiḥ saḥ evaiḥ mumurat
ca rājase kratvā variṣṭham vare āmurim uta ugram ojiṣṭham tavasam tarasvinam
oṃ indrāya dvādaśa nṛmedha auṣṇihaṃ saptamyupāntye ca kakubhau

column2: mahaḥ sasṛjmahe udāiva yantaḥ udabhiḥ vāḥ tvā yavyābhiḥ vardhanti
suteṣu indra girvaṇaḥ śrāyantaḥiva sūryam viśvā it indrasya bhakṣata vasūni jāte
